title: Quantum anomalies from three-point on-shell bootstrap
summary: We bootstrap quantum anomalies using on-shell techniques in the simplest setting: at three points. The necessary field-theoretic input includes the local or global classical symmetry, which the anomaly may break, and the symmetries of the effective action --- though not its explicit form. We use massless helicity spinors together with an on-shell representation of the discrete C, P, and T transformations.
